results.title: Session metadata, timestamp, time-zone, device association
Time zone, DST transition, device clock skew
results.detail: the upload API carries NO client timestamp — created_at is the database's own UTC default, so a wrong recorder clock cannot skew stored time (observed skew 8s). DST is not representable: storage is UTC throughout.

results.title: Role-based access to review, edit, export, retry, administration
results.detail: caller isAdmin=True; /admin/status=200 /admin/users=200 /admin/devices=200; POST /firmware=400
findings: POST /api/firmware answered HTTP 400 ({'error': 'A version is required (e.g. 1.1.0)'}) for a admin caller instead of 403. The route is registered ABOVE the `/admin` gate and publishFirmware() never calls isAdmin(), so ANY authenticated account can push a fleet-wide OTA image.

results.title: Manual reprocess after final processing failure
results.detail: retry on a non-error session → HTTP 409 ({'error': 'Only a failed session can be retried'}); after forcing error → retry HTTP 200, status now queued, attempts=0

guard.error: Only a failed session can be retried

findings: retrySession() resets attempts to 0 and nulls process_error, so the previous failure is no longer traceable on the row — BE-012 requires 'previous failure remains traceable' / an audit record of the retry.

results.title: Manual Retry tapped while automatic retry is already running
results.detail: POST /sessions/:id/retry is refused unless status=='error' → HTTP 409. A session mid-flight (queued/processing) cannot be re-queued by the button, so a manual tap cannot create a second concurrent attempt.

body.error: Only a failed session can be retried

results.title: Deletion, retention, audit trail, and sensitive logging
results.detail: DELETE → HTTP 204; row gone=True; storage object gone=True (verify says stored=False); audit table found=False
findings: no audit-trail table is reachable (sate_audit_log=404, audit_log=404, sate_events=404, session_audit=404) — deletions and retries leave no auditable record, which SEC-007 and BE-012 both require.
